claims.claim: The exact forward-KL radius of the closed three-bit two-product-mixture model is -3/4 log(2 sqrt(3)-3) nats.
Only the two uniform parity targets maximize the three-bit radius; each has four translated nearest distributions.
A finite certificate covers all real target weights, with 52 roots, 16600 leaves, 93792 vertex conditions, 552 parity equality incidences and maximum depth 20.
The rational target interface returns exact feasible mixture parameters and a reconstruction trace, not a generally optimal projection.
For n>=3 and k>=2^(n-2), the n-bit k-product-mixture radius is at most the same natural-log constant.
